And we are not what we appear either. Each man, woman and child is entangled in it. This tree of darkness grows, its roots deep in our souls. I cannot get it out. It is a part of me. The harvesters are coming! Do not open your eyes!
我们也并非表面所示的样子。每个男人、女人、孩子都被它缠住。这棵黑暗之树在生长，根须深扎于我们的灵魂。我拔不掉它。它是我的一部分。收割者来了！别睁开眼睛！

The Unseen Spectrum A warning to those who are not content with the knowledge they have There exists a world beyond what we see. Our perception is limited, as though we are in a fog. Just as the wind blows and we do not see, so is there light that we cannot see.
不可见的光谱 致那些不满足于既有知识之人： 在我们所见之外，另有一个世界。我们的知觉是有限的，仿佛身处迷雾之中。正如风在吹而我们不能看见，同样也有光，是我们无法看见的。

All that we do not know is but a fog, our knowledge and memories a limit to our perception and conception. Yet, that which is beyond us still moves and has volition. It does not need our understanding to continue along. We are blind, that is, unless our eyes are opened.
我们所有不知之物，皆是一团迷雾；我们的知识与记忆，限制着我们的感知与理解。然而，超乎我们之外的事物依然在运动，依然有其意志。它并不需要我们的理解才能继续前行。我们是盲的，除非我们睁开双眼。

My eyes were opened. I wish to close them now, but I cannot. I have seen that which is unseen. There are beautiful colors. The elements themselves swirl about us, some taking physical shape to roam the land.
我的双眼被睁开了。如今我想闭上它们，却办不到。我看见了那不可见之物。有美丽的色彩。元素本身在我们周围旋涌，有些还化作实体，在大地上游荡。

And there is evil, dark and wicked, seeking to devour everything. The shadows themselves live and breathe. They watch us, waiting patiently for the light to fade! And there are harvesters, working the fields of our minds. They are taking the fruit and I know not why! I shut my eyes but I can still see them!
而那里还有邪恶，黑暗、凶残，想要吞噬一切。阴影本身也活着，在呼吸。它们注视着我们，耐心等待光明消退！还有收割者，在我们的心田里劳作。他们在收割果实，而我不知为何！我闭上眼睛，却仍能看见他们！
